Name: Building Menu Anywhere
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
Allows the player to open the building menu from anywhere with a configurable key, as if you are at Robin's. Default is B.




[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]﻿
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.1.8+.




[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the Building Menu Anywhere folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
Load Stardew Valley using [b]SMAPI[/b].﻿
Press B (or the key you changed it to) to open it.
